name: Mega-Cap Tech Valuation Snapshot: Who's Cheapest?
description: Cross-sectional bar charts of P/E, P/S, EV/EBITDA, P/B across mega-cap tech peers with summary table and time series. Answers: which mega-cap tech stock is cheapest on each valuation metric today? Run with --start 2019-01-01.
source:
# =============================================================================
# MEGA-CAP TECH VALUATION SNAPSHOT: WHO'S CHEAPEST?
# =============================================================================
# Question: Which mega-cap tech stock is cheapest on each valuation metric today?
#
# Charts:
#   1. cs_bars — Grouped bars: P/E, P/S, EV/EBITDA per asset
#
# Note: P/B excluded — book value is unreliable for tech (intangibles),
#   and mixing quarterly balance_sheet P/B with TTM income_statement
#   ratios in cs_summary_table triggers a data pipeline bug.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Fundamental data
inc_data = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)()
bs_data = balance_sheet(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()

# Forward-fill to daily frequency
eps = ffill(inc_data.basic_eps)
shares = ffill(inc_data.basic_shares)
revenue = ffill(inc_data.revenue)
ebitda_val = ffill(inc_data.ebitda)
lt_debt = ffill(bs_data.lt_debt)
cash_val = ffill(bs_data.cash)

# Valuation multiples
pe = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_earnings, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(
    c=close, basic_eps=eps, basic_shares=shares
).value

ps = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_sales, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(
    c=close, revenue=revenue, basic_shares=shares
).value

ev_ebitda = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.ev_to_ebitda, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(
    c=close, basic_shares=shares, ebitda=ebitda_val, lt_debt=lt_debt, cash=cash_val
).value

# Bar-safe values (0.0 when NaN — asset may lack sufficient fundamental data)
pe_bar = pe if is_valid(pe) else 0.0
ps_bar = ps if is_valid(ps) else 0.0
eve_bar = ev_ebitda if is_valid(ev_ebitda) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Valuation Multiples at a Glance',
    category='Valuation Snapshot',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Multiple',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Slate, Color.Cyan],
    series_names=['P/E', 'P/S', 'EV/EBITDA']
)(pe_bar, ps_bar, eve_bar)
